description: This file implements a WebSocket client class (`WsClient`) for real-time game sessions in a Flutter mobile app. It manages connections to a WebSocket server, supports authenticated connections, heartbeat pings, reconnect logic with exponential backoff, message handling, and session resumption placeholder.

classes.name: WsClient
classes.description: A WebSocket client tailored for real-time game sessions, supporting login, heartbeat, reconnection, and session resumption.

methods.name: setResumeToken
methods.description: Sets the placeholder token for resuming sessions.

methods.name: connect
methods.description: Establishes a WebSocket connection, unless in mock mode or already connected; can be forced.

methods.name: disconnect
methods.description: Closes the WebSocket connection and resets reconnection attempts.

methods.name: send
methods.description: Sends a JSON-encoded message through the WebSocket.

methods.name: dispose
methods.description: Disposes of resources, cancels timers, subscriptions, and closes the WebSocket.
